hooks.name: KiroGraph Sync on Delete
hooks.description: Remove deleted files from the KiroGraph index. Only marks the index dirty — the actual sync is deferred to the Stop hook, because every sync costs ~3-4 min (full scan + global symbol resolve) and running it inline on each delete would both block and collide with a sync already in flight.

action.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" || exit 0; kirograph mark-dirty >>.kirograph/hook.log 2>&1 || true
